passes.note: PASS concept: threshold escalation is mechanical and local-only. Direct decision-doc edits are diagnostic only; first REVIEW round with >=2 countable verified/legacy medium+ reviewer findings triggers DONE review escalation; full path requires 3 rounds x 2 independent PASS hosts, explicit degraded fallback is 3 rounds x 1 host with assuranceLevel=degraded-single-host, and authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone remain false.
